modules.name: minisvc.config
modules.purpose: Defines immutable Settings and loads database/read-only configuration from an environment mapping.

modules.name: minisvc.models
modules.purpose: Defines the Order data model containing order_id, customer, and total_cents.

modules.name: minisvc.storage.repo
modules.purpose: SQLite persistence for the orders table, including schema initialization, insert, and lookup.

modules.name: minisvc.audit
modules.purpose: Builds in-memory order event dictionaries for create and read responses; it has no storage side effects.

modules.name: minisvc.api.handlers
modules.purpose: Translates API payloads into Orders, invokes repository operations, and formats create/get responses.

modules.name: minisvc.api.routes
modules.purpose: Registers POST /orders and GET /orders/<order_id> callbacks on an application adapter.

modules.name: minisvc.cli
modules.purpose: CLI bootstrap: loads environment settings, constructs the repository, initializes SQLite schema, and prints readiness.

modules.name: minisvc, minisvc.api, minisvc.storage
modules.purpose: Package marker files only; no business logic or runtime flow.

key_functions.description: Maps MINISVC_DB to database_path (default orders.sqlite) and MINISVC_READONLY == 1 to readonly; returns frozen Settings.
Bootstraps the service repository and schema, then prints readiness and returns 0; argv is unused.
Stores the configured database path as a pathlib.Path.
Creates orders(order_id primary key, customer, total_cents) if absent using a SQLite transaction.
Inserts an Order into SQLite; duplicate IDs and other SQLite errors propagate; no retry is implemented.
Queries by order_id and reconstructs an Order or returns None.
Binds application adapter routes to create_order and get_order lambdas.
Indexes required payload keys, converts total_cents with int(), saves the order, and returns a created response with an in-memory event.
Reads an order and returns either missing or serialized order data plus an in-memory read event.
Constructs a dictionary event; does not write to a durable audit table.

runtime_flows.name: CLI startup
steps: Executable minisvc resolves to minisvc.cli:main via pyproject.toml.
main reads os.environ and calls minisvc.config.load_settings.
load_settings selects MINISVC_DB or orders.sqlite and records MINISVC_READONLY.
main calls repo.init_schema, which creates the SQLite orders table if needed.
main prints minisvc ready at <database path> and returns 0.

runtime_flows.name: HTTP create-order
steps: register_routes binds POST /orders to a lambda invoking create_order(payload, repo).
create_order reads order_id, customer, and total_cents from the payload.
total_cents is converted with int() and an Order is instantiated.
repo.save inserts the Order into SQLite in its own connection context.
order_event constructs an in-memory created event.
The handler returns status created, order_id, and event; no audit persistence or retry occurs.
